headline: Binance Restores Withdrawals After Completing $6.3 Billion Recovery
summary: Binance announced that withdrawal recovery work is complete across nearly all networks following a $6.3 billion crypto theft, stating the platform can fully cover losses.
why: As the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by volume, security incidents and liquidity freezes at Binance carry systemic implications for digital asset valuations and market sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Resolution of a major exchange security crisis relieves severe systemic fear across the digital asset market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The successful completion of recovery work and the resumption of withdrawals across nearly all networks reassured investors after a massive security breach.
